nina_newhire: hey! newbie question — where should I keep my daily ramp notes vs official team docs in Notion? also how do i get edit access to the onboarding templates?
leo_devex: welcome! personal ramp notes -> Notion 'My Pages' or create a private page under Team Docs > Onboarding > Private Ramps. Official docs live in Team Docs > Product > Onboarding and go through docs-review. To edit templates ping @trina_docs.
trina_docs: @nina_newhire I can add you. Which template? 'Engineer Ramp (private)' or the locked 'Engineer Ramp (canonical)'? Private one is fine for personal edits.
nina_newhire: private one please. and any preferred page title format so managers can find it?
leo_devex: use "Ramp - <firstname> <lastname>" and add a tag or property #ramp #private. If you want to later promote notes to canonical, use the docs-review flow (link in Team Docs > Process).
it_sync_bot: System: Notion SSO invite queued for trina_docs to grant access. Expect email within 10 minutes.
trina_docs: invite sent to your company email. If you don't see it, check spam or ping me and i'll troubleshoot SSO sync.
nina_newhire: got it, thanks :smile:
